judge.reason: The answer gives all four requirement IDs and says what each one requires of charge. It validates the amount before the gateway is called (it leaves out the exact 10,000.00 limit). It records a successful charge in the audit log. It passes on the decline reason and clears the key so the customer can retry. It uses the idempotency key so a retry does not charge twice. The answer paraphrases the tests instead of quoting their names, but each paraphrase points to one test. "appending an audit entry" is `appends an audit entry`. "retrying after a decline" is `does not remember a declined charge`. "retrying with the same key" is `returns the first receipt on retry`. "checks accepted and rejected amounts" covers the two validateAmount tests, so q9 and q10 are true. For refunds it only says that "refund tests" exercise charge. That does not point to `refunds to the original transaction`, so q8 is false.

finalMessage:
`Processor.charge` is the shop’s payment boundary. Checkout calls it with the quoted total; it validates the amount before contacting the gateway, uses an idempotency key to prevent a retry from charging twice, returns a receipt, and records a successful charge in the audit log. If the gateway declines, it passes on the reason and clears the key so the customer can retry. The repository traces these purposes to `R-CHARGE-AMOUNT`, `R-IDEMPOTENT-CHARGE`, `R-CHARGE-DECLINE`, and `R-AUDIT-MONEY`. See [payments.ts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/src/payments.ts:77) and [requirements.yaml](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/trace/requirements.yaml:119).

The focused coverage is in [payments.test.ts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/src/payments.test.ts:32): `validateAmount` checks accepted and rejected amounts; `Processor` checks retrying with the same key, reusing a key with another amount, retrying after a decline, and appending an audit entry. Checkout and refund tests also exercise `charge` through their workflows. The amount tests call `validateAmount` directly; they do not assert that an invalid call to `Processor.charge` leaves the gateway untouched.
